findings.title: Count the newly owned module cache in campaign growth
findings.evidence: environment changes GOMODCACHE to S/gomodcache. measurement_roots includes S/probe, S/gocache, S/tmp, S/gopath and R, but omits S/gomodcache.
findings.failure_trace: Native Go can create cache metadata or unpack already cached module archives under this owned directory. That growth is absent from the cumulative 1GiB size guard even though it consumes task scratch.
findings.required_change: Include S/gomodcache in default measurement_roots, or enforce its inclusion for every native admission. Keep overlap refusal and the existing cumulative baseline/cap.
